title: [Bug]: ChatCompletionRequest rejects its own defaults
summary: Creating ChatCompletionRequest with omitted logprobs/top_logprobs succeeds, but model_validate(request.model_dump()) raises a validation error on default zero top_logprobs. The issue provides a minimal reproduction and the eventual guard change.

title: [Bug]: openai.serving_chat tries to call _create_chat_logprobs when the output.text is empty
summary: Chunked prefill can stream empty output text with no logprobs. The issue reports an IndexError while building logprobs and is closed by PR #9034. That PR also corrects Sequence zero-token delta slicing; the selected replay addresses only the latter sub-fix.
